objectives: Decode taught sw-words by mapping graphemes from left to right.
Blend the sw onset with the vowel and remaining sounds.
Distinguish sw from other taught blends without guessing.
Self-correct by checking every grapheme and rereading the whole word.
concepts: Decoding maps graphemes to sounds in order.
The sw onset contains s then w.
Every remaining grapheme must be decoded.
Rereading checks that no sound was omitted.

definitions.definition: A letter or group of letters representing a speech sound.
Use grapheme-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Notice and repair an error using sound and word evidence.

workedExamples.solution: Map s-w-i-m, blend the sounds, then say swim.
Keep s and w in order, then read the rest.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads swan as san. What should happen?
workedExamples.solution: Return to w after s, map each grapheme, and reread swan.
